newsitem.title: JAPAN: Itochu, Nissho Iwai to invest in Qater LNG firm.
newsitem.headline: Itochu, Nissho Iwai to invest in Qater LNG firm.

text.p: Trading house Itochu Corp said on Tuesday that it and Nissho Iwai Corp have agreed to purchase stakes in a Qatar liquid natural gas enterprise Ras Laffan Liquefied Natural Gas Co.

Itochu and Nissho Iwai plan to hold four percent and three percent respectively in the firm, which is currently 70 percent owned by state-owned Qatar General Petroleum Corp and 30 percent by Mobil Corp, an Itochu spokesman said.
The firm is developing gas fields in northern Qatar. It expects to start supplying 2.4 million tonnes of liquid natural gas annually to the Korean Gas Corp in the summer of 1999, the spokesman said.
The firm is expected to produce a total of 10 million tonnes of liquid natural gas a year starting from 1999.
Traders had said Sumitomo Corp was also interested in acquiring a stake in Rasgas, but a Sumitomo spokesman told Reuters on Tuesday that the company had decided not to do so.
"There was a large gap between the conditions we sought and their conditions, so we have decided not to acquire a stake at this time," the Sumitomo spokesman said.
